parameter_sources.H: density scale height -1/(d ln rho/dz), derived before averaging
parameter_sources.N2: height integral of signed -g*d(ln rho)/dz - g²/cs², derived before averaging
parameter_sources.a: height integral of supplied horizontal mean of local Alfven speed; cm/s to km/s, native thermal grid
parameter_sources.dz: absolute separation of the selected cube-layer centres
parameter_sources.phi_deg: direction of height-integrated unit vector, atan2(By,Bx) from +x toward +y
parameter_sources.theta_deg: direction of height-integrated unit vector, inclination from +z
parameter_sources.wac: height integral of cs/(2 H_rho), locally isothermal cutoff

provenance.alfven_limitation: Supplied native horizontal mean of local Alfven speeds; independently verified from a native staggered layer. Direction is still inferred from horizontally averaged cube components.
provenance.buoyancy_assumption: NC2010 Eq. 4 assumes a hydrostatic adiabatic background. Pressure-gradient buoyancy and hydrostatic gravity are diagnostic comparisons when pressure is supplied; dynamic snapshot averages need not obey hydrostatic balance. Gamma1_effective is not assumed to equal Cp/Cv.
provenance.buoyancy_definition: N2 = -g*d ln rho/dz - g²/cs² (Newington & Cally 2010 Eq. 4); signed s^-2
provenance.cutoff_definition: isothermal acoustic cutoff for the existing locally isothermal NC2009 relation; non-isothermal cutoff retained in diagnostics
provenance.geometry: bb1=x=xc1, bb2=y=xc2, bb3=z=xc3 upward; x-z propagation plane is the xc1-xc3 plane
provenance.gravity_source: explicit atmospheric_profiles.gravity_km_s2, default solar magnitude 0.274; absent from files
provenance.height_coordinate: native xc3 minus xc3[0], as in the time_distance pipeline
provenance.height_units: km; unitless legacy profile z verified against recorded cube bins in cm
provenance.magnetic_units: Cube fields converted to physical G; internal convention, factor 3.5449077018110318. CO5BOLD internal B/sqrt(4pi) follows the original MHD manual.
provenance.propagation_limitation: The k_h diagram is horizontally azimuth-averaged; phi is relative to the selected xc1 reference plane, not a measured unique propagation direction.
provenance.reduction: horizontal means of the exact profile snapshot; cube fields are already vertically binned
provenance.scale_height_definition: H_rho = -1/(d ln rho/dz), nonuniform-coordinate gradient before height averaging
provenance.stored_frequency_limitation: Legacy real N does not encode signed N2; stored cutoff retained only for diagnostic comparison.
provenance.temporal_limitation: One atmospheric snapshot represents the full time series used by the k–omega diagram.
provenance.unit_contract_basis: User confirmed cm/s sound speed and rad/s frequencies on 2026-10-13. Temperature follows the notebook K-to-kK convention. The adiabatic-index diagnostic is dimensionless; its thermodynamic definition remains unverified.
provenance.vertical_limitation: Magnetic components retain the cube resolution; density derivatives use the native profile when supplied. Interpolation cannot recover unresolved magnetic structure.

unavailable.g: Gravity is not supplied by these profiles; retain the authoritative model constant.
unavailable.gamma: The profile adiabatic_index has no verified Cp/Cv definition; not substituted for the radiative models’ specific-heat ratio.
unavailable.tau: Radiative relaxation time is not supplied by these profiles.

coherence_weighting.alignment: linear interpolation on kh/nu; no extrapolation; undefined cells have zero visibility
coherence_weighting.application: coherence multiplies the existing Gaussian model display once; combined spectral weight = T*C*H(C-C_min); solver fields unchanged

estimator.averaging_note: Pooled coefficient counts are not effective independent degrees of freedom; annular stationarity and local frequency smoothing are assumed.
estimator.axes: exact FFT coordinates; kh angular rad/Mm, nu cyclic mHz; omega=2*pi*nu/1000 rad/s
estimator.baseline: selected original/post-magnetogram cubes before current Gaussian

input_provenance.provenance: saved atmospheric cube/height provenance; observable from canonical pipeline name or saved megaplot metadata

estimator.preprocessing: global mean removed; full-record rectangular window; common complete spatial time-series mask
estimator.spectral_units: periodogram density of independently normalized velocities; common factors cancel in coherence

gaussian_filter.hermitian_symmetry: explicit conjugate-index symmetric real transfer; imaginary inverse-FFT residual checked
gaussian_filter.normalization: per-k profile divided by its maximum only if that maximum exceeds 1
gaussian_filter.preview_application: independent 3-D filtering of both Dopplergrams; checked inverse FFT; native TimeDistance phase recalculation
gaussian_filter.preview_sampling: Gaussian constructed directly on stored diagram axes; signed frequency half reconstructed using nt parity
